item.title: Chaos as Teargas Disrupts Sifuna’s Rally in Kitengela
item.description: The leaders were attending a rally in Kitengela after a church service in the area.

item.title: Moha ‘Jicho Pevu’ Responds to Rumors Linking Him to DCP Gubernatorial Bid
item.description: Gachagua introduced the Nyali MP before the PCEA congregants, stating that Ali would be running for the Governorship of Mombasa County.

item.title: Gachagua to Storm IG Kanja's Offices This Week
item.description: Gachagua claims that despite repeated complaints, the IG is still reluctant to guarantee him security during his events.

item.title: Police Issue Update on Witima Church Incident Amid Gachagua's Plans to Visit IG Kanja
item.description: Gachagua had earlier indicated he would visit IG Kanja's offices to learn of any updates on the ACK Witima church incident.

item.title: Police Nab Ugandan Trying to Smuggle Missing Child at Kenya-Tanzania Border
item.description: A mother's worst nightmare almost came true, but quick-thinking detectives stopped the child trafficker before he could flee.

item.title: Burial Delayed After Relative’s SHA Identity Fraud Sparks Investigation
item.description: A man who attempted to help his brother through SHA fraud is now under investigation by the police and the Ministry of Health for fraudulent activity.

item.title: KPA Clarifies Mass Recruitment
item.description: The authority is among the most highly sought-after government parastatals, with many Kenyans seeking jobs in the port authority.

item.title: Three Police Officers Die After Tragic Road Accident
item.description: Reports indicate that one of the police officers died on the spot, while the other two and the civilian succumbed to their injuries after being rushed to the hospital.

item.title: Nairobi County to Introduce New Monthly Fee for All Residents
item.description: The fee is expected to be added on all water bills in the capital as part of the raft of changes Sakaja is implementing to boost revenues.

item.title: Mystery as Govt Audit Leaves Out 500,000 Students
item.description: The audit comes after the Ministry of Education audit, where it revealed that there were 87,000 ghost students who were being capitalised over Ksh1 billion.
